title: Transport the canonical model adjunct before finite Kummer normalization
statement: Let l be prime and Y and P=ProjectiveLine Y be Noetherian with DiagonalTraceLocalizations, and let s be UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport]. Give p:NormalizedAdjunctPair(s), consisting of z:completedUnit(P)→completedLine(P)[2] normalized against firstChern(O(1)) by the local root-limit equation, and c:completedUnit(Y)→tq.Rc(completedLine(P)[2]) with exactly the original sourceMap normalization against systemChern [def-diagonal-uniformizer-adjunct-conditions, def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation, def-sp-tower-class-chern]. Then p.Transported holds: the fourfold image of c through the prescribed pushforward endpoints equals the fourfold unit endpoint followed by the ordinary finite adjunct of localUnitInv, localFunctor(z), localLine [def-diagonal-uniformizer-local-endpoints, sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology, lem-diagonal-finite-trace-chern-criterion]. This does not identify that local coefficient image with the finite Kummer class, and assumes no trace or degree identity.

proof.text: Apply completed_adjunct_square to the supplied normalized pair. This gives the first completed-realization square.

Apply the proved abstract coefficient_adjunct_transport assembly theorem. Unfold the prescribed localFunctor, localUnitInv and localLine endpoints, and associate compositions to identify its localAdjunctArrow with the arrow in Transported.
